## Gray Ape Decurion (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
Tombotu fighter 2  
LN Large monstrous humanoid  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +12  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 12, flat-footed 21 (+6 armor, +3 Dex, +4 natural, +2 shield, -1 size)  
**hp** 75 (7d10+37)  
**Fort** +8, **Ref** +7, **Will** +4 (+1 vs. fear)  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft. (20 ft. in armor), climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** longsword +12/+7 (2d6 + 5/19-20), bite +6 (1d8 + 2) or bite +6 (1d8 + 2), 2 claws +6 (1d6 + 2 plus grab)  
**Ranged** javelin +9 (1d8 + 5)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** rend (2 claws, 1d6 + 7)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 17, **Con** 18, **Int** 15, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +13 (+17 grapple); **CMD** 26  
**Feats** Alertness, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Legionnaires’ Inspiration, Saving Shield, Step Up, [Weapon Focus (longsword)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (longsword).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +1 (-3 to jump), Climb +13, Diplomacy +5, Intimidate +7, Perception +12, Profession (sailor) +10, Sense Motive +2, Stealth +1, Swim +9  
**Languages** Althindu, Common, Elven, Halfling, Tombotu  
**Other Gear** breastplate, heavy steel shield, javelin, longsword  
**Special Abilities** legionnaires’ inspiration (2 rounds, 3/day) As standard action, grant all allies within 60’ that can hear you a +1 morale bonus to AC.  

**Saving Shield** As an immediate action, add a 2 shield bonus to an adjacent ally’s AC.  

**Step Up** If a foe makes a 5 ft. step away from you, you can move 5 ft to follow them.
